dialogue.user:
Thanks for the options! I'm looking for women's shoes. They're for everyday formal wear — office and such. 

I like the sound of the **Anne Klein Womens Oalise** — it has great ratings and lots of reviews, and the price is well within my budget. Could you tell me a bit more about what materials they're made of and if they're comfortable for all-day wear?
dialogue.agent:
Here's the full scoop on the **Anne Klein Womens Oalise**:

**Price:** $35.48 | **Rating:** ★ 4.4 (141 reviews)

**Materials & Features:**
- **Upper & lining:** Synthetic (durable and easy to maintain)
- **Sole:** Rubber
- Low kitten heel for comfortable all-day wear
- Flexible and durable outsole for added comfort and support
- Available in both medium and wide widths
- Slip-on design

**What customers are saying:**
The reviews are overwhelmingly positive! Two verified buyers rave about the comfort — one says they're "super cozy" with "extra cushion," and another loyal Anne Klein buyer says they're "super comfortable," look nice, and need no break-in period. One reviewer did note that the soles can be slippery on smooth surfaces and that they run slightly small, so you may want to consider sizing up if you have wider feet.

Overall, with a 4.4 average from 141 reviews and the low kitten heel plus flexible outsole, these seem like a solid choice for all-day office wear. Would you like to go ahead with these?

top_reviews.title: Great for skinny feet and comfort
top_reviews.text: Ok. LOVE this shoe. Super cozy, extra cushion AND stylish. Some reviews said to go up a size because they are narrow in the toe, but I have skinny and flat feet and my “normal” shoe size is a perfect fit.

top_reviews.title: Loyal Anne Klein shoe buyer
top_reviews.text: Anne Klein does it right every time. I can order online because it always has the same fit. These shoes are super comfortable and look really nice. I’ve tried many other brands for my work shoes and Anne is the only one who gets me, comfy and stylish and never a need to “break in” her shoes.

top_reviews.title: Disappointed
top_reviews.text: I am amazed to see how much the quality of Anne Klein products have deteriorated! I bought two pairs of AK shoes. Surprised to see that that the shoes had hardly any friction on the  soles!!! Getting things made in China is not serving the customers but definitely stuffing the pockets of higher level management and owners. The shoes run small. The sole is thin smooth piece of plastic.. Poor quality and watch out very slippery even on dry hard wood floor or ceramic tiles. Personally I will look for higher end shoes that are made in Europe or USA, may be pricy but will be reliable, safe, and worth the money.
